source_inspections.evidence_extract: The Department of Labor final rule removes 20 CFR 652.215 and the requirement that states use state merit staff to provide Wagner-Peyser Employment Service services, effective October 19, 2026. It permits rather than requires alternative staffing; preserves federal performance, civil-rights, unemployment-eligibility and migrant and seasonal farmworker safeguards; acknowledges insufficient data for comprehensive cost-benefit analysis; and removes a mandatory staffing-model evaluation.
